map.💡 公式：制冷量 = 面积 × 单位负荷 × 层高修正 × 朝向系数；1 匹 ≈: Formula: cooling = area x unit load x height factor x orientation factor; 1 HP ~ 2500W cooling. Each 0.1m above 2.8m height adds 3% cooling.
map.本结果为经验估算，顶层、西晒、落地窗等应适当放大一档: This is an empirical estimate; top floor, west sun, floor-to-ceiling windows, etc. should step up one size
map.制热场景建议在制冷量基础上预留 20% 余量: For heating, add ~20% margin on top of cooling capacity
map.出租房或办公室按面积快速配机，套入『面积×层高×指标』即可得出制冷量，再除以 2: For rentals or offices, quickly size by area: area x height x factor gives cooling, divide by 2324 for HP; can be done mentally.
map.做多房间批量初配时，先统一用面积法得出各间基准匹数，再对特殊房间单独加余量，减少: For batch sizing of many rooms, first get a base HP per room by area, then add margin to special rooms, cutting per-room work.
map.向客户或家人解释为什么『10㎡ 用 1 匹、20㎡ 用 2 匹』时，用面积法最直: To explain '10 m2 uses 1 HP, 20 m2 uses 2 HP' to clients or family, the area method is most intuitive for setting expectations.
map.使用面积 15㎡，层高 2.8m\n制冷量 = 15 × 2.8 × 200 ≈:
Usable area 15 m2, height 2.8m
Cooling = 15 x 2.8 x 200 ~ 8400W
8400 / 2324 ~ 3.6 HP -> choose 1.5 HPx2 or 3 HP cabinet
map.面积法为什么有时偏大？: Why can the area method overestimate?
map.面积法用统一指标，未扣除墙体/家具占用与人员密度差异；密闭好、人少的房间实际负荷: The area method uses a uniform factor, ignoring wall/furniture occupancy and occupant-density differences; well-sealed, low-occupancy rooms have lower load and can drop half an HP.
map.层高超过 3m 怎么处理？: How to handle ceiling height over 3m?
map.层高越高单位面积负荷越大，公式中层高直接乘入；挑空客厅建议按实际体积并叠加 20: Higher ceilings mean higher load per area; height is multiplied directly in the formula. For double-height living rooms, use actual volume and add 20% margin.
map.变频和定频影响选型吗？: Do inverter and fixed-speed affect sizing?
map.变频机低频稳温更省电，可按基准匹数选；定频机频繁启停，建议留 10%–20% 余: Inverter units hold temperature at low frequency and save energy, so pick base HP; fixed-speed units cycle often, so leave 10%-20% margin to avoid long under-load running.
